snippet.text:
@[expose] def loop (s r : Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if h : s < r then
    loop (s + 1) (r - (s + 1))
  else
    (s - r, r)
termination_by r
decreasing_by
  exact Nat.sub_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le s) h) (Nat.succ_pos s)
